name: CatPhysics.foraging_grows_iff
statement:
theorem foraging_grows_iff (F a c d s dt : ℝ) (ht : 0 < dt) :
    F ≤ foragingStep F a c d s dt ↔ d * s ≤ a * c

name: CatPhysics.balanced_foraging
statement:
theorem balanced_foraging (F a c d s dt : ℝ) (h : a * c = d * s) :
    foragingStep F a c d s dt = F

name: CatPhysics.couch_increases_iff
statement: theorem couch_increases_iff (S d c : ℝ) : S ≤ couchStep S d c ↔ c ≤ d

name: CatPhysics.couch_can_decrease
statement: theorem couch_can_decrease : couchStep 10 1 3 < 10

name: CatPhysics.entropyTrajectory_monotone
statement:
theorem entropyTrajectory_monotone (S : ℝ) (d c : ℕ → ℝ) (h : ∀ n, c n ≤ d n) :
    Monotone (entropyTrajectory S d c)

name: CatPhysics.humanServitudeConstant_value
statement: theorem humanServitudeConstant_value : humanServitudeConstant = 1

name: CatPhysics.box_preferred_to_zero
statement:
theorem box_preferred_to_zero (boxPotential : ℝ) (h : boxPotential < 0) :
    boxPotential < (0 : ℝ)

name: CatPhysics.sigmoid_pos
statement: theorem sigmoid_pos (z : ℝ) : 0 < sigmoid z

name: CatPhysics.sigmoid_lt_one
statement: theorem sigmoid_lt_one (z : ℝ) : sigmoid z < 1

name: CatPhysics.sigmoid_zero
statement: theorem sigmoid_zero : sigmoid 0 = 1 / 2

name: CatPhysics.sigmoid_strictMono

name: CatPhysics.sigmoid_injective
statement: theorem sigmoid_injective : Function.Injective sigmoid

name: CatPhysics.compliance_bounds
statement:
theorem compliance_bounds (p : ComplianceParameters) (power yield : ℝ) :
    0 < compliance p power yield ∧ compliance p power yield < 1

name: CatPhysics.compliance_mono_power
statement:
theorem compliance_mono_power (p : ComplianceParameters) (h : 0 ≤ p.powerGain)
    {x y : ℝ} (hxy : x ≤ y) (yield : ℝ) :
    compliance p x yield ≤ compliance p y yield

name: CatPhysics.compliance_mono_yield
statement:
theorem compliance_mono_yield (p : ComplianceParameters) (h : 0 ≤ p.yieldGain)
    {x y : ℝ} (hxy : x ≤ y) (power : ℝ) :
    compliance p power x ≤ compliance p power y

name: CatPhysics.zero_powerGain
statement:
theorem zero_powerGain (p : ComplianceParameters) (h : p.powerGain = 0) (x y z : ℝ) :
    compliance p x z = compliance p y z

name: CatPhysics.negative_powerGain_reverses
statement:
theorem negative_powerGain_reverses {p : ComplianceParameters} (h : p.powerGain < 0)
    {x y : ℝ} (hxy : x < y) (z : ℝ) : compliance p y z < compliance p x z

name: CatPhysics.sampledMean_nonneg
statement:
theorem sampledMean_nonneg {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (h : ∀ i, 0 ≤ x i) :
    0 ≤ sampledMean x

name: CatPhysics.sampledMean_const
statement:
theorem sampledMean_const {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (c : ℝ) :
    sampledMean (fun _ : Fin n => c) = c

name: CatPhysics.sampledMean_le
statement:
theorem sampledMean_le {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) (B : ℝ)
    (h : ∀ i, x i ≤ B) : sampledMean x ≤ B

name: CatPhysics.sampled_purr_power_bounds
statement:
theorem sampled_purr_power_bounds {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (a f p : ℝ) (t : Fin n → ℝ) :
    0 ≤ sampledMean (fun i => purrPower a f p (t i)) ∧
    sampledMean (fun i => purrPower a f p (t i)) ≤ a ^ 2

name: CatPhysics.optimal_exists
statement: theorem optimal_exists (score : Action → ℝ) : ∃ a, Optimal score a

name: CatPhysics.optimal_shift_iff
statement:
theorem optimal_shift_iff (score : Action → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (a : Action) :
    Optimal (fun b => score b + c) a ↔ Optimal score a

name: CatPhysics.optimal_scale_iff
statement:
theorem optimal_scale_iff (score : Action → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (a : Action) :
    Optimal (fun b => c * score b) a ↔ Optimal score a

name: CatPhysics.constant_score_ties
statement: theorem constant_score_ties (c : ℝ) (a : Action) : Optimal (fun _ => c) a

name: CatPhysics.maximizer_need_not_be_unique
statement:
theorem maximizer_need_not_be_unique :
    ∃ score : Action → ℝ, Optimal score .meow ∧ Optimal score .loaf ∧
      Action.meow ≠ Action.loaf

name: CatPhysics.optimal_scores_equal
statement:
theorem optimal_scores_equal {score : Action → ℝ} {a b : Action}
    (ha : Optimal score a) (hb : Optimal score b) : score a = score b

name: CatPhysics.compliance_utility_bounded
statement:
theorem compliance_utility_bounded (v : ActionValues) (hk : 0 ≤ v.kappa)
    (hp : ∀ a, 0 ≤ v.complyProbability a ∧ v.complyProbability a ≤ 1) (a : Action) :
    v.expectedTreats a + v.eta * v.statusChange a ≤ utility v a ∧
    utility v a ≤ v.expectedTreats a + v.eta * v.statusChange a + v.kappa

name: CatPhysics.toy_meow_optimal
statement: theorem toy_meow_optimal : Optimal toyScore .meow

name: CatPhysics.toy_meow_unique
statement: theorem toy_meow_unique {a : Action} (h : Optimal toyScore a) : a = .meow

name: CatPhysics.schrodinger_inner_derivative_zero
statement:
theorem schrodinger_inner_derivative_zero {n : ℕ}
    (H : ℝ → HilbertState n →ₗ[ℂ] HilbertState n)
    (ψ : ℝ → HilbertState n) (t : ℝ)
    (hH : (H t).IsSymmetric)
    (hψ : HasDerivAt ψ ((-Complex.I) • H t (ψ t)) t) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s => inner ℂ (ψ s) (ψ s)) 0 t

name: CatPhysics.schrodinger_inner_conserved
statement:
theorem schrodinger_inner_conserved {n : ℕ}
    (H : ℝ → HilbertState n →ₗ[ℂ] HilbertState n)
    (ψ : ℝ → HilbertState n)
    (hH : ∀ t, (H t).IsSymmetric)
    (hψ : ∀ t, HasDerivAt ψ ((-Complex.I) • H t (ψ t)) t) (s t : ℝ) :
    inner ℂ (ψ s) (ψ s) = inner ℂ (ψ t) (ψ t)

name: CatPhysics.schrodinger_norm_conserved
statement:
theorem schrodinger_norm_conserved {n : ℕ}
    (H : ℝ → HilbertState n →ₗ[ℂ] HilbertState n)
    (ψ : ℝ → HilbertState n)
    (hH : ∀ t, (H t).IsSymmetric)
    (hψ : ∀ t, HasDerivAt ψ ((-Complex.I) • H t (ψ t)) t) (s t : ℝ) :
    ‖ψ s‖ = ‖ψ t‖

name: CatPhysics.schrodinger_normalization_preserved
statement:
theorem schrodinger_normalization_preserved {n : ℕ}
    (H : ℝ → HilbertState n →ₗ[ℂ] HilbertState n)
    (ψ : ℝ → HilbertState n)
    (hH : ∀ t, (H t).IsSymmetric)
    (hψ : ∀ t, HasDerivAt ψ ((-Complex.I) • H t (ψ t)) t)
    (h0 : ‖ψ 0‖ = 1) (t : ℝ) : ‖ψ t‖ = 1

name: CatPhysics.matrix_schrodinger_norm_conserved
statement:
theorem matrix_schrodinger_norm_conserved {n : ℕ}
    (H : ℝ → Operator n) (ψ : ℝ → HilbertState n)
    (hH : ∀ t, (H t).IsHermitian)
    (hψ : ∀ t, HasDerivAt ψ ((-Complex.I) • (H t).toEuclideanLin (ψ t)) t)
    (s t : ℝ) : ‖ψ s‖ = ‖ψ t‖

name: CatPhysics.totalHamiltonian_norm_conserved
statement:
theorem totalHamiltonian_norm_conserved {n : ℕ}
    (f : ℝ → Fields n) (human : ℝ → Operator n) (gamma : ℝ) (power : ℝ → ℝ)
    (ψ : ℝ → HilbertState n)
    (hE : ∀ t, (f t).exploration.IsHermitian) (hF : ∀ t, (f t).foraging.IsHermitian)
    (hM : ∀ t, (f t).tactile.IsHermitian) (hW : ∀ t, (f t).coherence.IsHermitian)
    (hH : ∀ t, (human t).IsHermitian)
    (hψ : ∀ t, HasDerivAt ψ ((-Complex.I) •
      (totalHamiltonian (f t) (human t) gamma (power t)).toEuclideanLin (ψ t)) t)
    (s t : ℝ) : ‖ψ s‖ = ‖ψ t‖

name: CatPhysics.angularFrequency_pos
statement: theorem angularFrequency_pos {f : ℝ} (hf : 0 < f) : 0 < angularFrequency f

name: CatPhysics.purrPower_nonneg
statement: theorem purrPower_nonneg (a f p t : ℝ) : 0 ≤ purrPower a f p t

name: CatPhysics.purrPower_le_amplitude_sq
statement: theorem purrPower_le_amplitude_sq (a f p t : ℝ) : purrPower a f p t ≤ a ^ 2

name: CatPhysics.silent_purr
statement: theorem silent_purr (f p t : ℝ) : purrPower 0 f p t = 0

name: CatPhysics.purr_at_origin
statement: theorem purr_at_origin (a f : ℝ) : purr a f 0 0 = 0

name: CatPhysics.purrPower_sign_invariant
statement:
theorem purrPower_sign_invariant (a f p t : ℝ) :

name: CatPhysics.empty_harmonicStack

theorem empty_harmonicStack (a : Fin 0 → ℂ) (f p : Fin 0 → ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    harmonicStack a f p t = 0

name: CatPhysics.harmonicStack_add
statement:
theorem harmonicStack_add {n : ℕ} (a b : Fin n → ℂ) (f p : Fin n → ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    harmonicStack (a + b) f p t = harmonicStack a f p t + harmonicStack b f p t

name: CatPhysics.coupling_symmetric
statement: theorem coupling_symmetric (l a b p q : ℝ) : coupling l a b p q = coupling l b a q p

name: CatPhysics.coupling_synchronized
statement: theorem coupling_synchronized (l a b p : ℝ) : coupling l a b p p = l * a * b

name: CatPhysics.coupling_zero_strength
statement: theorem coupling_zero_strength (a b p q : ℝ) : coupling 0 a b p q = 0

name: CatPhysics.coupling_le_synchronized
statement:
theorem coupling_le_synchronized (l a b p q : ℝ) (h : 0 ≤ l * a * b) :
    coupling l a b p q ≤ coupling l a b p p

name: CatPhysics.opposite_phase_coupling
statement: theorem opposite_phase_coupling : coupling 1 1 1 Real.pi 0 = -1

name: CatPhysics.statePower_nonneg
statement: theorem statePower_nonneg {n : ℕ} (ψ : State n) : 0 ≤ statePower ψ

name: CatPhysics.zero_state_not_normalized
statement: theorem zero_state_not_normalized {n : ℕ} : ¬ Normalized (0 : State n)

name: CatPhysics.statePower_smul
statement:
theorem statePower_smul {n : ℕ} (c : ℂ) (ψ : State n) :
    statePower (c • ψ) = Complex.normSq c * statePower ψ

name: CatPhysics.unit_phase_preserves_normalization
statement:
theorem unit_phase_preserves_normalization {n : ℕ} (c : ℂ) (hc : Complex.normSq c = 1)
    (ψ : State n) (hψ : Normalized ψ) : Normalized (c • ψ)

name: CatPhysics.unit_phase_preserves_mode_power
statement:
theorem unit_phase_preserves_mode_power {n : ℕ} (c : ℂ) (hc : Complex.normSq c = 1)
    (ψ : State n) (i : Fin n) : Complex.normSq ((c • ψ) i) = Complex.normSq (ψ i)

name: CatPhysics.expectation_real
statement:
theorem expectation_real {n : ℕ} (A : Operator n) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (ψ : State n) :
    (rawExpectation A ψ).im = 0

name: CatPhysics.expectation_add
statement:
theorem expectation_add {n : ℕ} (A B : Operator n) (ψ : State n) :
    expectation (A + B) ψ = expectation A ψ + expectation B ψ

name: CatPhysics.expectation_real_smul
statement:
theorem expectation_real_smul {n : ℕ} (r : ℝ) (A : Operator n) (ψ : State n) :
    expectation (r • A) ψ = r * expectation A ψ

name: CatPhysics.hermitian_real_smul
statement:
theorem hermitian_real_smul {n : ℕ} (r : ℝ) (A : Operator n) (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    (r • A).IsHermitian

name: CatPhysics.mastery_yield
statement:
theorem mastery_yield {n : ℕ} (s : Signals n) (b : SignalWeights) (ψ : State n) :
    expectation (mastery s b) ψ =
      b.blink * expectation s.blink ψ + b.headbutt * expectation s.headbutt ψ +
      b.loaf * expectation s.loaf ψ + b.meow * expectation s.meow ψ

name: CatPhysics.mastery_hermitian
statement:
theorem mastery_hermitian {n : ℕ} (s : Signals n) (b : SignalWeights)
    (hB : s.blink.IsHermitian) (hN : s.headbutt.IsHermitian)
    (hL : s.loaf.IsHermitian) (hM : s.meow.IsHermitian) :
    (mastery s b).IsHermitian

name: CatPhysics.totalHamiltonian_hermitian
statement:
theorem totalHamiltonian_hermitian {n : ℕ} (f : Fields n) (human : Operator n)
    (gamma power : ℝ) (hE : f.exploration.IsHermitian) (hF : f.foraging.IsHermitian)
    (hM : f.tactile.IsHermitian) (hW : f.coherence.IsHermitian) (hH : human.IsHermitian) :
    (totalHamiltonian f human gamma power).IsHermitian

name: CatPhysics.hermitian_powerRate_zero
statement:
theorem hermitian_powerRate_zero {n : ℕ} (H : Operator n) (hH : H.IsHermitian)
    (ψ : State n) : powerRate H ψ = 0

name: CatPhysics.euler_step_power
statement:
theorem euler_step_power (dt : ℝ) :
    Complex.normSq (1 - Complex.I * (dt : ℂ)) = 1 + dt ^ 2

name: CatPhysics.euler_step_grows
statement:
theorem euler_step_grows {dt : ℝ} (h : dt ≠ 0) :
    1 < Complex.normSq (1 - Complex.I * (dt : ℂ))
